tasks.name: 创建博客数据模型
tasks.description: 设计博客的数据模型，包括标题、内容、图片路径和创建日期，并保存到数据库。

tasks.name: 创建博客API接口
tasks.description: 开发后端API接口，支持博客的增删改查功能，包括图片上传处理。

tasks.name: 实现图片上传功能
tasks.description: 开发后端图片上传功能，支持图片的存储和路径保存到数据库。

tasks.name: 创建首页
tasks.description: 创建首页HTML页面，包含导航栏和欢迎信息，提供跳转到博客列表页和创建页的链接。

tasks.name: 创建博客列表页
tasks.description: 创建博客列表HTML页面，展示所有博客的标题、内容摘要、缩略图和创建日期，并提供查看详情、编辑和删除按钮。

tasks.name: 创建博客详情页
tasks.description: 创建博客详情HTML页面，展示完整的博客标题、内容、图片和创建日期，并提供编辑和删除按钮。

tasks.name: 创建博客创建页
tasks.description: 创建博客创建HTML页面，包含标题、内容输入框和图片上传组件，支持提交表单创建新博客。

tasks.name: 创建博客编辑页
tasks.description: 创建博客编辑HTML页面，预填充当前博客内容，允许用户修改标题、内容和图片并保存。

tasks.name: 实现博客删除功能
tasks.description: 开发后端删除功能，支持通过API删除指定博客，并更新前端页面。

tasks.name: 实现博客编辑功能
tasks.description: 开发后端编辑功能，支持通过API更新博客内容和图片。

tasks.name: 实现前端表单验证
tasks.description: 在创建和编辑页面中实现前端表单验证，确保用户输入完整且图片格式正确。

tasks.name: 实现错误提示和跳转逻辑
tasks.description: 在前端实现表单提交后的错误提示和成功跳转逻辑，确保用户体验流畅。

T1.implementation_approach: Design a database schema with fields like title, content, author, created_at, and updated_at.
T1.notes: Consider scalability and indexing for efficient querying.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful API endpoints for CRUD operations on the blog model.
T2.notes: Ensure proper authentication and validation for secure access.

T3.implementation_approach: Integrate a file upload library to handle image uploads and store them in a designated directory or cloud storage.
T3.notes: Validate file types and size limits for security.

T4.implementation_approach: Create a homepage layout with navigation links and featured blog posts using HTML/CSS and JavaScript.
T4.notes: Ensure responsiveness for different screen sizes.

T5.implementation_approach: Develop a page to list all blogs with pagination and search functionality.
T5.notes: Optimize database queries for large datasets.

T6.implementation_approach: Create a detailed view page to display the full content of a blog post.
T6.notes: Include related posts or comments for better engagement.

T7.implementation_approach: Design a form for users to input blog details and submit them to the backend via API.
T7.notes: Implement client-side validation for better user experience.

T8.implementation_approach: Create a page to fetch and display existing blog data in an editable form.
T8.notes: Pre-fill the form with current blog details for easy editing.

T9.implementation_approach: Implement a delete API endpoint and add a confirmation dialog in the frontend.
T9.notes: Ensure proper authorization before allowing deletion.

T10.implementation_approach: Develop an update API endpoint and integrate it with the blog edit page.
T10.notes: Validate updated data before saving changes.

T11.implementation_approach: Add client-side validation using JavaScript or a library like Formik to ensure correct input formats.
T11.notes: Provide real-time feedback to users during form filling.

T12.implementation_approach: Implement error handling in the frontend and backend, and redirect users to appropriate pages based on the error type.
T12.notes: Display user-friendly error messages for better clarity.
